title: Dry-Clean Spend by Garment Type
dataSources: Closet activity (`style:wardrobe`), cleaning tasks (`style:cleaning`), shoe wears (`style:shoes`), beauty inventory (`beauty:product`), audits (`style:audit`).
app: Wardrobe and beauty telemetry — Stylebook closet exports, dry-cleaning reminders, shoe-rotation logs, and makeup inventory audits — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=style:cleaning garment_type=* spend_usd=*
| stats avg(spend_usd) as avg_spend_usd, count as events by garment_type
| sort - avg_spend_usd
description: Shows average dry-clean spend by garment type for cleaning bills.
value: Average dry-clean spend by garment type helps compare cleaning bills across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `spend_usd` on `style:cleaning` events and normalize `garment_type` so Splunk can summarize performance by garment type.
visualization: Bar chart of average dry-clean spend by garment type.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights the average dry-clean spend for each garment type so you can see what works best for cleaning bills.
